title: Leaf Cutter
description: LeafCutter is a PaperMC plugin that allows players to instantly cut all connected leaf blocks by shift-clicking with shears
body:
🪓 Leaf Cutter

Leaf Cutter is a lightweight quality-of-life plugin that makes clearing tree leaves fast and satisfying.
Simply shift-click leaf blocks with shears to instantly break all connected leaves of the same type, saving time and effort when harvesting or cleaning up builds.

The plugin uses vanilla mechanics for drops and durability, includes built-in safety limits to prevent lag, and is designed to work reliably across modern Minecraft servers.

✨ Features

- Shift-click with shears to break connected leaves
- Only affects the same leaf type
- Uses vanilla drops and durability
- Performance-safe with a configurable block limit (internal)
- No commands, no setup — just works

🔧 Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21+
- Servers: 
- Paper 1.21 - 1.21.11 (1.21.x tested),
- Purpur, 
- Spigot (1.21.5 tested)
- Java: 17+
